correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source projector hypotheses exactly. A depth-\(L\) edge-local circuit keeps \(UZ_vU^\dagger\) inside \(B_G(v,L)\); the Clifford projector factorizes across every qubit subset; Clifford conjugation is uniform over nonidentity Pauli classes; and exactly \(4^{|B_G(v,L)|}-1\) such classes are supported in the ball. Algebraic inversion gives the error threshold. No finite enumeration is used to prove the infinite family.

value.rationale: The result supplies a natural complete architecture-sensitive obstruction for the source problem. It converts the line-specific \(L+1\) lightcone count into an exact graph-ball law and yields the clean threshold \(L\ge\operatorname{diam}(G)\) for every fixed error below \(3/4\). This distinguishes path, cycle, grid, expander, and dense architectures in the physically relevant edge-local circuit model. It is more than a renamed parameter substitution because the geometric support set and the all-vertices diameter consequence must be established for arbitrary graphs; no claim of general-graph tightness is made.
